# Wander & Tales

> A free, multilingual library of cooperative, no-lose story-adventure kits for a
> grown-up and a child to share. Read every story online in English, Spanish,
> Italian, and Portuguese, or print the kits. Nobody competes, nobody loses, and
> there are no wrong answers. Calm enough for bedtime.

A grown-up (a parent, grandparent, teacher, childminder or group leader) and one or
more children play together with a single die and a few household objects. No app,
no login, no ads. There are seven worlds and twenty-one stories, each with a Tale
Book (two reading levels), an Atlas (map and pictures), and a World Book.

## Start here
- [How to Play](https://www.wanderandtales.com/en/how-to-play): the one-page guide to playing a kit.
- [Why it matters](https://www.wanderandtales.com/en/why): the evidence, with cited sources, kept associational (a way to practise, not a promise).
- [Create your own story](https://www.wanderandtales.com/en/create): make your own kit with Claude.

## Worlds
- [The Floating Isles](https://www.wanderandtales.com/en/worlds/floating-isles)
- [The Sunlit Hills of Greece](https://www.wanderandtales.com/en/worlds/greek-myth)
- [The Snowlit Fjords of the North](https://www.wanderandtales.com/en/worlds/norse-myth)
- [The Blossom Mountains of Yamato](https://www.wanderandtales.com/en/worlds/japanese-myth)
- [The Emerald Isles of the Celts](https://www.wanderandtales.com/en/worlds/celtic-myth)
- [The Windswept Shores of Troy](https://www.wanderandtales.com/en/worlds/trojan-cycle)
- [The Enchanted Springs of Portugal](https://www.wanderandtales.com/en/worlds/enchanted-springs)

## Key facts
- Free and non-commercial; content licensed CC BY-SA 4.0, code MIT.
- Cooperative and no-lose: you win by being kind and full of ideas, and every idea counts.
- For any grown-up and a child: parents, grandparents, teachers, childminders, group leaders.
- Four languages (en-GB, es-ES, it-IT, pt-PT), each at two reading levels.
- Screen-free play: read online or print, with a single die and household objects.
- Source and licence: https://github.com/agigante80/wander-and-tales
